system.prerequisites: At least 2 ranks in any two of Arcana, Culture, Medicine, Nature, Occultism, Planes or Religion
system.description:
ADEPT EXPERT

Books taught you the principles. Adventuring taught you which paragraph matters when something enormous is trying to eat you.
You may select a Specialist Lore skill.
Furthermore, you also gain the following action:
APPLIED INSIGHT
CONCENTRATE FOCUS
Action 1 AP
You may select any one Studied Target that you can see and gain one of the following modifiers until the beginning of your next turn:
Opening You gain a +1-circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the Studied Target.
Warning You gain a +1-circumstance bonus to DB and saving throws against the Studied Target's attacks, spells and abilities.

Prerequisites At least 2 ranks in any two of Arcana, Culture, Medicine, Nature, Occultism, Planes or Religion

Progression Requirements Any qualifying knowledge skill +10 ranks

Works automatically: Use this feat to name your Lore specialist skill; Applied Insight arrives as a Focus ability.

specialistChoice.label: A Specialist Lore skill
specialistChoice.prompt: The Lore your studies centre on
